# Epsilon Technology
> Premium IT Software Development, Mobile Apps, Web Applications & Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency.

Epsilon Technology is a global technology and digital marketing company founded by Jaydeep Kataria. We specialize in custom software engineering, mobile application development (iOS/Android), Next.js web applications, eCommerce systems, WhatsApp Business API automation, and specialized social media patient acquisition for doctors & hospitals.

- Website: https://epsilon-technology.com
- Contact Email: contact@epsilon-technology.com
- Founder: Jaydeep Kataria (https://epsilon-technology.com/about-us/)
- Main Locations: India (Junagadh, Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara, Morbi) · UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) · UK · USA · Canada

## Core Services

- Web Development: High-performance Next.js, React, full-stack web applications. (https://epsilon-technology.com/services/web-development/)
- Mobile App Development: Native & cross-platform React Native / Flutter apps. (https://epsilon-technology.com/services/mobile-app-development/)
- eCommerce Development: Bespoke high-converting storefronts, Shopify, payment gateways, pan-India logistics. (https://epsilon-technology.com/services/ecommerce-development/)
- WhatsApp Business API Automation: Automated customer onboarding, appointment booking, and verified business messaging. (https://epsilon-technology.com/product/whatsapp-business-api/)
- Lead Generation & Performance Marketing: Meta & Google Ads funnels generating 30-50+ qualified inquiries monthly. (https://epsilon-technology.com/lead-generation/)
- Doctor & Healthcare Marketing: Specialized patient acquisition, IMC-compliant healthcare reels, and clinic branding. (https://epsilon-technology.com/digital-marketing/)

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- DearPet.in: Pet grooming booking web app handling 50+ daily automated bookings. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/dearpet/)
- Ontapp.ca: High-concurrency on-demand delivery eCommerce platform across Canadian provinces. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/ontapp/)
- Junagadh Police App: Mission-critical police bandobast and geofenced attendance mobile app. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/junagadh-police/)
- Prabhav Lagnam: Verified community matrimonial mobile application with 10,000+ active profiles. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/prabhav-lagnam/)
- Soni Book: Community genealogy, interactive family trees, and live chat app. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/soni-book/)
- W3LP.io: Web3 multi-chain NFT creation & smart contract minting platform (50,000+ NFTs minted). (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/w3lp/)
- Enicet Bathware: Luxury sanitaryware eCommerce generating ₹4,000+ daily sales. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/enicet/)
- Ira Organic Shop: D2C cold-pressed oils eCommerce with 1-click checkout. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/ira-organic/)
- Orza Cooktops: Flame-free infrared cooktop D2C eCommerce store. (https://epsilon-technology.com/portfolio/orza/)
